summary: The diff adds a dedicated multi-month (3/6) month/year selector and centralizes date-range calculations into a new utility module, then wires ReportsPage to compute full-month start/end timestamps for monthly, 3-month, and 6-month windows. However, the provided truncated diff does not show evidence that the Financial Summary header text was updated to reflect the selected start/end dates for 3- and 6-month ranges.

missing_requirements.requirement: The Financial Summary header reflects the correct start and end dates for the selected 3-month range.
missing_requirements.reason: ReportsPage.tsx is truncated before the UI/header rendering, so there is no evidence that the Financial Summary header displays the computed startDate/endDate for the 3-month selection.

missing_requirements.requirement: The Financial Summary header reflects the correct start and end dates for the selected 6-month range.
missing_requirements.reason: ReportsPage.tsx is truncated before the UI/header rendering, so there is no evidence that the Financial Summary header displays the computed startDate/endDate for the 6-month selection.

hallucinated_features.description: Added generic date-range utilities beyond the requested monthly/3-month/6-month windows (e.g., full-year range, single-day range, and date-range formatting).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on 3-month and 6-month range selection and consistent full-month windows across monthly/3/6-month types; it does not request new daily/year range utilities or formatting helpers.
